probe.title: Home | Lucci Lambrusco
probe.text_sample: Home | Lucci Lambrusco About the Wine Where to Sip Explore Our Recipes Get in Touch Meet the dry sparkling red wine, crafted in Emilia-Romagna, Italy Co-founded by Ashley Graham Bubbly. Balanced. Fruit-forward. Fall in Love WIth Lambrusco Looking for something refreshing, bold, and a little unexpected? Meet Italy’s original sparkling red wine. Naturally vibrant, lightly fizzy, perfectly balanced, and always enjoyed chilled. Whether pairing with good food or great company, this is the wine your glass has been waiting for. Learn More Drink Chilled. Stay Bubbly. Drink Chilled. Stay Bubbly. Meet the Woman Behind the Bubbles For years, our co-founder Ashley Graham has had one go-to wine: Lambrusco. But despite being her drink of choice for happy hours and dinner parties alike, it was impossible to find at her local wine shop or on the menu at her favorite restaurants. So Ashley did what she always does... Made it happen. Partnering with fifth generation wine makers in Emilia-Romagna, Italy, the Lambrusco capital of the world, Lucci is a bold and refreshing sparkling red wine that makes every gathering, big or small, feel like a celebration where everyone is invited.
